cohort: The study included 52 infants with myelomeningocele (MMC) treated at a single center between April 2006 and July 2023.
finding: CM-II infants exhibited significantly larger intracranial and lateral ventricle volumes, but smaller posterior cranial fossa and cerebellum volumes compared to non-CM-II infants, with lateral ventricle volume being the best predictor for distinguishing CM-II.
